newsitem.title: GERMANY: US suitor loses interest in Germany's Traub - paper.
newsitem.headline: US suitor loses interest in Germany's Traub - paper.

text.p: U.S.-based machinery producer Cincinatti Milacron has ended discussions aimed at a takeover of insolvent German tool-maker Traub AG, a German newspaper said on Thursday.
The Stuttgarter Zeitung said however that German tool-making company Gildemeister was still interested in Traub, as were other unnamed investors in the U.S. and Asia.

Cincinatti Milacron was widely rumoured to have been the U.S. group mentioned by Traub's court-appointed administrator in October as having expressed an interest in the company. The U.S. group had however never declared its interest.
Traub declared itself insolvent in October and the company's founding Traub van Kempen family said they were willing to part with their 27 percent stake in a bid to attract new investors in the firm.
